comments.text: I am sharing a experience of mine. On May 2024 I purchased a Livpure water purifier for my country home. This year September is started malfunctioning, it was beeping & water was not coming out. I had taken 2 yrs extended warranty Rs 999 of One Assist while purchasing from Flipkart. As 1 year (manufacturer's warranty) was already over, I contacted One Assist. They informed the regional Livpure manager about the issue and arranged a agent. The agent called us before visiting and demanded Rs 500. We informed One Assist Customer Care & as expected our case got highlighted & resolution was given to us after 4 days. The resolution was we have not to give the Rs 500, but the service agent was not agreeing. Finally after a heated argument with both parties simultaneously, I took them in conference. Then they came to an agreement that One Assist would pay the service agent Rs 500 with the repairing cost. Now I what I mean is that I live in Kolkata a tier 1 city, my grand mother lives in a tier 3 village alone she had arrange drinking water from her neighbors for more than a week. Even in Kolkata hassle free service is not provided by One Assist. My father has faces many issues as he works as a senior maintenance manager in a hospital in the heart of the city and many items in his hospital has converge of One Assist Insurance.
